$comment: The one list of tests. `pnpm test`, .github/workflows/ci.yml and .github/workflows/publish.yml all run
it through scripts/run-tests.mjs; none of them may enumerate test files on their own (run-tests.mjs --check
refuses). Every test/*.mjs must appear exactly once: under `tests` (run everywhere) or under `excluded`
with the reason it cannot run in CI. Names in test/required-tests.json can never move to `excluded`.
timeout is in seconds, per test, and generous on purpose (Windows laptops are slower than the runner).

excluded.smoke.mjs: writes to ~/.linksee-memory-test under the real home directory
excluded.smoke-v0.1.0.mjs: writes to ~/.linksee-memory-test-v010 under the real home directory
excluded.smoke-v0.3.0.mjs: writes to ~/.linksee-memory-v030-test under the real home directory
excluded.smoke-read-smart.mjs: writes to ~/.linksee-memory-test-rs under the real home directory
excluded.setup-settings.mjs: existing setup bug, not a home-directory risk (the test is isolated: temp HOME/USERPROFILE/LINKSEE_MEMORY_DIR). On Linux with a read-only ~/.claude, setup fails first in the skill install step (src/bin/setup.ts, mkdirSync EACCES) before the settings write case runtime B checks; passes on Windows. Settings-preservation regressions are therefore not caught on Linux until setup is fixed (separate PR), then this moves back to tests + test/required-tests.json
